abilities.name: On da March
abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **^^Kruleboyz Infantry^^** units can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if they used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.timing: Start of Any Turn
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Killabeak's Talons and Beak** is 5.

abilities.name: Screamin' Mandrakk
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Spell^^** ability
abilities.effect: This unit uses the 'Unbind' ability but the unbinding roll is 3D6 instead of 2D6.

abilities.name: Crush to Death
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: Mork Sez No!
abilities.effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster. If the unbinding roll was 10+, inflict D6 mortal damage on the caster instead.

abilities.name: Strangle Hex
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Vulcha's Talons and Beak** is 5.

abilities.name: Commanding View
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly **Gutrippaz** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Vulcha Dive
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: That's Ours, Ya Gitz
abilities.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: All Part of da Plan
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

units.name: Killaboss on Great Gnashtoof (Scourge of Aqshy)

abilities.name: Prowling the Flanks
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Drag 'Em Out
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Infantry Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. Then, if possible, your opponent must remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit.

abilities.name: Keep 'Em in Line
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'All-out Attack' command for a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Infantry^^** unit
abilities.effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of the unit using the 'All-out Attack' command, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by that unit for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Unleash the Stab-grot!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the turn.
After resolving either effect, remove this unit's **Stab-grot** from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Stab-grot
abilities.effect: This unit's **Stab-grot** is a token. If this unit's **Stab grot** has been removed, it can no longer attack with its **Stab-grot's Shiv** and it cannot use the 'Unleash the Stab-grot!' ability.

abilities.name: Just Keep Stabbin'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to your fury level. You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do:
• Add 1 to each roll.
• If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Jump 'Em, Ladz, Or Else!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect:
Pick a friendly **Gutrippaz** or **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target.
The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Power of Kragnos
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Breath of the Mire-drakes
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 1, this ability has no effect. On a 2-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Klutcha-grot
abilities.effect: This unit's **Klutcha-grot** is a token. If it is removed from the battlefield, this unit cannot use the 'A Tough Grot to Swallow' ability.

abilities.name: Bait and Trap
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is damaged. On a 3+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: A Tough Grot to Swallow
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Rampage^^** ability for an enemy **^^Monster^^** within 6" of this unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, that **^^Rampage^^** ability has no effect. On a 1, remove this unit's **Klutcha-grot** from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Man-skewer Crossbows
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, pick either the **Hasty Shot** or **Aimed Shot** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Man‑skewer Crossbows**.

abilities.name: Pick 'Em Off
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit has not used a **^^Move^^** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Pot-grot
abilities.effect: This unit's **Pot-grot** is a token. Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit while its **Pot-grot** is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less for this unit, remove its **Pot-grot** from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Foul Elixirs
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Sloppklaw's Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Kountin' Krew
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target's **Slitta-knives** have **Crit (Mortal)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Aggravate Wounds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Bet-master
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be **the bet**.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit and friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** units that target **the bet**.

abilities.name: Tear Limb From Limb
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Infantry^^** unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: Breaka-harness
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
Make a breaka-roll of D3.
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on this unit equal to the breaka-roll.
• Double the breaka-roll and add that value to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Mirebrute's Clubs** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.timing: Start of Any Turn
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Skewering Bolts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Beast-skewer Bolts** is 6 if the target is a **^^Monster^^**.

abilities.name: Pick 'Em Off
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit has not used a **^^Move^^** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Scare Taktikz
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by non-**^^Hero^^** units that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Scrap-bang
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Sludgeraker's Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Festering Wounds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn by attacks made by this unit or a friendly unit with the **^^Sludgeraker Venom^^** keyword to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the end of the next turn.

abilities.name: Sludgeraker Venom
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: That unit has the **^^Sludgeraker Venom^^** keyword for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Toxic Stash
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Infantry Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Kompany Taktikz
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Dirty Tricks
abilities.effect:
The effect of a **^^Dirty Trick^^** ability is only applied if you make a successful dirty trick roll. The success of a dirty trick roll depends on the number of **^^Dirty Trick^^** abilities your army has already used this battle round:
**First:**  2+
**Second:** 3+
**Third:** 4+
**Fourth or subsequent:** 5+

abilities.name: Venom-encrusted Weapons
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Infantry^^** unit to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target's attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

abilities.name: Lethal Surprise
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, for the rest of the turn, the target's weapons cannot be affected by the Charge (+1 Damage) weapon ability

abilities.name: Sneaky Sneakin'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Infantry^^** unit that has 10 or fewer models,  is not in combat and has not been the target of a **^^Dirty Trick^^** ability this turn to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Noisy Racket
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
abilities.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Choking Mist
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Da Black Pit
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Mork's Kunnin'
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit wholly within 12" of them, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to save rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit

abilities.name: Tattermask
abilities.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, that attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Spell in a Rattle
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use a non-**^^Summon^^** **^^Spell^^** ability from a spell lore you picked during army composition as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 9 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound.

abilities.name: Woggly Bogstikk
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Swamp Staff
abilities.effect: If this unit is not a **^^Wizard^^**, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Otherwise, add 1 to this unit's power level.

abilities.name: Mork's Eye Pebble
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an **^^Attack^^** ability
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Eye-biter Ash
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ded Sneaky
abilities.effect: You can use the 'Sneaky Sneakin'' **^^Dirty Trick^^** ability twice per turn instead of only once per turn.

abilities.name: Meanest Beasts
abilities.effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

abilities.name: Swamp Shroud
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** units that are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature are not visible to enemy units that are more than 12" away from them.

abilities.name: Far-killa Bolts
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Man-skewer Boltboyz** or **Beast skewer Killbow** units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets' ranged weapons.

abilities.name: Slippery Skumbag
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, it can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: Egomaniak
abilities.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**^^Hero Kruleboyz^^** Infantry unit:
• This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**^^Hero Kruleboyz Infantry^^** unit within this unit's combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Backstabba
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with both this unit and another friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted for each friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit in combat with the target in addition to the first two **^^Kruleboyz^^** units.

abilities.name: Summon Foot of Gork
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Summon Gork-Roara
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Kruleboyz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Sly 'Un
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Quick 'Un
abilities.effect: Add half your fury level (rounding up) to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Spittin' 'Un
abilities.effect: This unit is armed with **Caustic Saliva**, where X is equal to your fury level.

abilities.name: Mean 'Un
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit's **Companion** weapons.

abilities.name: Sneaky 'Un
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^Retreat^^** abilities this phase.

abilities.name: Tough 'Un
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.
